correctness_review: Design::members first accepts exact active non-top hierarchy paths already indexed from Slang instances and generate scopes. Other inputs retain the existing symbol/default resolution path. Module names and symbol identifiers still select declaration-default members; a top path identical to its module name retains that documented default behavior. Unknown paths continue to fail through resolve rather than returning a successful empty result.
isolation_and_identity_review: Returned members are selected by exact containing_scope equality, preventing sibling or descendant leakage. Existing indexed SymbolReference objects and identifier construction remain unchanged; IDs round-trip through describe_symbol. Kind filtering and pagination remain in the unchanged SemanticService handler. Empty valid generate scopes are distinguishable from invalid paths.
architecture_and_contract_review: The change stays inside the C++ Slang adapter and reuses its hierarchy index. No AST objects cross the adapter boundary, no subprocess compiler/parser is introduced, and no tools, request fields or response fields are added. The contract change documents scope acceptance and top/module ambiguity explicitly.
readability_review: The bounded hierarchy membership check and existing resolution fallback are straightforward. Complexity remains small and responsibilities are unchanged. No unnecessary abstraction or additional mutable state was introduced.
test_review: New regressions cover differently overridden sibling instances, effective widths, ID round-trips, kind filters and limits, module-default widths, top default IDs, both generated indices and their child instances, empty valid scopes and unknown scope failures.
